description: Turn a shopping list into a ready order for one grocery from find_groceries (pass its id, e.g. «d:82» or «b:abc12»). Returns the cleaned list and an order_url: Dukkani's order page with that grocery chosen and the list already written, so the customer only checks it and sends it on WhatsApp. This tool sends nothing by itself.

grocery_id.description: The id returned by find_groceries (d:<number> or b:<code>)

items.description: List lines, e.g. «2 حليب المراعي 1 لتر», «رز 5 كيلو», «كرتون بيض»

note.description: Optional note to the grocery (delivery time, «بدون سكر»…)

name: prepare_grocery_order
title: جهّز طلب مقاضي — Prepare a shopping-list order
